badges.name: Limestone Gate Passer
badges.description: Every journey begins with a single brave step. By reaching Station 1, you've taken the first stride into the heart of Hamiguitan.

badges.name: Mossy Trail Tracker
badges.description: Through the cool shade of the mossy forest, you've proven that persistence always carries you farther than you expect.

badges.name: Wildlife Path Explorer
badges.description: Reaching Station 3 shows your growing harmony with the forest. The deeper you go, the more the mountain reveals who you truly are.

badges.name: Mountain Ridge Climber
badges.description: Standing at Station 4, you rise above doubts and limits. High places reward not only strength, but courage.

badges.name: Cloud Forest Adventurer
badges.description: You've entered the cloud forest—where the air thins and your resolve strengthens. Few climb this far. You are becoming one of them.

badges.name: Pygmy Forest Visitor
badges.description: In the ancient bonsai forest, time slows down. By reaching Station 6, you've stepped into a world shaped by resilience and patience—much like your journey.

badges.name: Hidden Sea Trekker
badges.description: Tinagong Dagat rewards only those who dare to go beyond the ordinary path. You've reached a place hidden to most—proof of your determination.

badges.name: Final Ascent Pioneer
badges.description: The final ascent tests both strength and spirit. But you stood firm—because reaching Station 8 means believing that you can always rise again.

badges.name: Hamiguitan Peak Conqueror
badges.description: At the summit, the world appears smaller, and your courage feels greater. You've reached the peak—not just of the mountain, but of your own limits.

badges.name: Hamiguitan Trail Finisher
badges.description: Completing the Hamiguitan trail is more than finishing a journey—it is proving to yourself that perseverance transforms challenges into triumphs.

badges.name: First Trek Completed
badges.description: Starting something new is never easy. But you're here—you took the first step, finished your first trek, and opened the door to endless adventures.

badges.name: Two-Day Trek Survivor
badges.description: Enduring over a full day on the trail shows more than strength—it shows patience, grit, and a spirit that refuses to quit.

badges.name: Heritage Info Explorer
badges.description: Curiosity is the spark of discovery. By scanning your first QR sign, you opened your mind to Hamiguitan's stories and secrets.

badges.name: Bonsai Forest Learner
badges.description: Knowledge deepens experience. You've learned about the ancient bonsai forest—one of nature's quiet wonders.

badges.name: Wildlife Facts Collector
badges.description: Every species has a story, and you've begun to uncover them—one QR scan at a time. Curiosity is your compass.

badges.name: Zero-Waste Trekker
badges.description: True adventurers protect the trails they love. Your zero-waste journey reflects a heart that respects both nature and future trekkers.

badges.name: Leave No Trace Advocate
badges.description: You walked the trail with intention, respect, and discipline—leaving nothing behind but footprints and taking nothing but memories.

badges.name: Five Stations Completed
badges.description: Reaching five stations is no accident—it's the result of steady steps, quiet strength, and an unshaken spirit.

badges.name: 10km Milestone
badges.description: Ten kilometers is not just distance—it's persistence measured in footsteps, sweat, and determination.

badges.name: Elevation Gain 500m
badges.description: Climbing 500 meters means you've risen above challenges—literally and figuratively. Higher steps lead to greater views.

categories.name: Trail Completion
categories.description: Badges earned through courage, exploration, and progression along the Hamiguitan trail.

categories.name: Distance & Elevation
categories.description: Milestones that celebrate commitment, endurance, and the steady rise toward your goals.

categories.name: Biodiversity & Nature
categories.description: Achievements gained through curiosity and learning about the wonders of Hamiguitan.

categories.name: Conservation & Stewardship
categories.description: Badges honoring those who trek thoughtfully and protect the trails they explore.

categories.name: Social & Community
categories.description: Marks of shared experiences, camaraderie, and uplifting fellow trekkers.

categories.name: Challenge
categories.description: Prestigious badges for trekkers who push beyond limits and embrace adventure.
